object.name: MatterService.{i}.
object.description:
Matter standard is an interoperable application layer solution for smart home devices over the Internet Protocol.
This object describes the type of functionality that {{object}} is representing.
Each entry of this table represente a Matter Node. A Matter Node encapsulates an addressable, unique resource on the network that has a set of functions and capabilities that a user recognizes distinctly as a functional whole.
Depending on the functionality the corresponding sub-object is instantiated.

object.name: MatterService.{i}.Fabric.{i}.
object.description: A logical collection of communicating Nodes, sharing a common root of trust, and a common distributed configuration state.

parameter.name: NodeID
parameter.description: A Node Identifier (Node ID) is a 64-bit number that uniquely identifies an individual Node or a group of Nodes on a Fabric.

parameter.name: FabricID
parameter.description: A Fabric Identifier is a 64-bit number that uniquely identifies the Fabric within the scope of a particular root certificate authority.

parameter.name: CompressedFabricID
parameter.description: Conceptually, the fully qualified fabric reference consists of the tuple containing the public key of the root certificate authority, and the Fabric ID. In order to reduce the very large size of a full Fabric Reference which would need to be used as the scoping construct in the instance name, a 64-bit compressed version of the full Fabric Reference SHALL be used.

parameter.name: FabricNodeList
parameter.description: List of NodeIDs that are part of this Fabric.

object.name: MatterService.{i}.Endpoint.{i}.
object.description:
An Endpoint encloses a feature set.
For instance, an Endpoint might relate to a lighting functionality, while another relates to motion detection, and another deals with utilities such as Device OTA.

parameter.name: EndpointID
parameter.description: Index, or Endpoint-no, used in Matter (note: it may differ from the {{object}} index).

parameter.name: DeviceTypes
parameter.description:
The Matter specification requires that the device implement or extend one or more Device Types.
A Device Type is a collection of mandatory and optional Clusters that define the top-level attributes of a physical Device, such as Dimmable Light, Door Lock, or Video Player.
Describes a list of device types that can be represented.

object.name: MatterService.{i}.ColorControlCluster.{i}.
object.description:
Cluster Name: Color Control Cluster
Cluster ID: 0x0300
Cluter History:
* Revision 1 - Mandatory global ClusterRevision attribute added; CCB 2028
* Revision 2 - Added Options attribute, CCB 2085 2104 2124 2230; ZLO 1.0
* Revision 3 - CCB 2501 2814 2839 2840 2843 2861
* Revision 4 - All Hubs changes
* Revision 5 - New data model format and notation, FeatureMap support
* Revision 6 - Added clarifications to Scenes support for Matter
* Revision 7 - Added Q quality for CurrentHue, CurrentSaturation, CurrentX, CurrentY, ColorTemperatureMireds, EnhancedCurrentHue and RemainingTime attributes. Added clarifications for behavior related to Step values. Added constraints on minimum acceptable color temperature values in mireds.
* Revision 8 - Change WhitePoint* and ColorPoint* attributes from RW to R (CCB 2490, TCR 11893)
Cluster hierarchy: base
Cluster role: application
Cluster picsCode: CC
Cluster scope: Endpoint

object.name: MatterService.{i}.Network.Device.{i}.ColorControlCluster.{i}.
object.description:
Cluster Name: Color Control Cluster
Cluster ID: 0x0300
Cluter History:
* Revision 1 - Mandatory global ClusterRevision attribute added; CCB 2028
* Revision 2 - Added Options attribute, CCB 2085 2104 2124 2230; ZLO 1.0
* Revision 3 - CCB 2501 2814 2839 2840 2843 2861
* Revision 4 - All Hubs changes
* Revision 5 - New data model format and notation, FeatureMap support
* Revision 6 - Added clarifications to Scenes support for Matter
* Revision 7 - Added Q quality for CurrentHue, CurrentSaturation, CurrentX, CurrentY, ColorTemperatureMireds, EnhancedCurrentHue and RemainingTime attributes. Added clarifications for behavior related to Step values. Added constraints on minimum acceptable color temperature values in mireds.
* Revision 8 - Change WhitePoint* and ColorPoint* attributes from RW to R (CCB 2490, TCR 11893)
Cluster hierarchy: base
Cluster role: application
Cluster picsCode: CC
Cluster scope: Endpoint

Matter ID: 0x01

enumeration.description: Attempting to operate in the areas identified by the entries of the NewAreas field is allowed and possible. The SelectedAreas attribute is set to the value of the NewAreas field.
The value of at least one of the entries of the NewAreas field doesn't match any entries in the SupportedAreas attribute.
The received request cannot be handled due to the current mode of the device.

enumeration.description: Textual information meant for display when no other text representation is selected. It is used to clarify dialogue, alternate languages, texted graphics or location/person IDs that are not otherwise covered in the dubbed/localized audio.
Textual or audio media component containing a textual description (intended for audio synthesis) or an audio description describing a visual component
Simplified or reduced captions as specified in [United States Code Title 47 CFR 79.103(c)(9)].
A media characteristic that indicates that a track selection option includes frame-based content.
Main media component(s) which is/are intended for presentation if no other information is provided
A media characteristic that indicates that a track or media selection option contains original content.
A media characteristic that indicates that a track or media selection option contains a language translation and verbal interpretation of spoken dialog.
Textual media component containing transcriptions of spoken dialog and auditory cues such as sound effects and music for the hearing impaired.
Textual transcriptions of spoken dialog.
Textual media component containing transcriptions of spoken dialog and auditory cues such as sound effects and music for the hearing impaired.
Media content component that is supplementary to a media content component of a different media component type.
Experience that contains a commentary (e.g. director’s commentary) (typically audio)
Experience that contains an element that is presented in a different language from the original (e.g. dubbed audio, translated captions)
Textual or audio media component containing a textual description (intended for audio synthesis) or an audio description describing a visual component
Media component containing information intended to be processed by application specific elements.
Experience containing an element for improved intelligibility of the dialogue.

Experience that provides information, about a current emergency, that is intended to enable the protection of life, health, safety, and property, and may also include critical details regarding the emergency and how to respond to the emergency.
Textual representation of a songs’ lyrics, usually in the same language as the associated song as specified in [SMPTE ST 2067-2].

parameter.name: CurrentPositionLiftPercent100ths
CurrentPositionTiltPercent100ths
Mode
parameter.description:
Matter Element ID: 0x0017
Matter Element Access: {'read': 'true', 'write': 'true', 'readPrivilege': 'view', 'writePrivilege': 'manage'}
Bitmaps SHALL be encoded using the TLV unsigned integer type, with the width selected automatically at runtime based on the actual value.
Matter type: ModeBitmap
* Bit: 0
* Bitfield name: MotorDirectionReversed
* Bitfield summary: Reverse the lift direction.
* Bit: 1
* Bitfield name: CalibrationMode
* Bitfield summary: Perform a calibration.
* Bit: 2
* Bitfield name: MaintenanceMode
* Bitfield summary: Freeze all motions for maintenance.
* Bit: 3
* Bitfield name: LedFeedback
* Bitfield summary: Control the LEDs feedback.

parameter.name: SafetyStatus
parameter.description:
Matter Element ID: 0x001A
Matter Element Access: {'read': 'true', 'readPrivilege': 'view'}
Bitmaps SHALL be encoded using the TLV unsigned integer type, with the width selected automatically at runtime based on the actual value.
Matter type: SafetyStatusBitmap
* Bit: 0
* Bitfield name: RemoteLockout
* Bitfield summary: Movement commands are ignored (locked out). e.g. not granted authorization, outside some time/date range.
* Bit: 1
* Bitfield name: TamperDetection
* Bitfield summary: Tampering detected on sensors or any other safety equipment. Ex: a device has been forcedly moved without its actuator(s).
* Bit: 2
* Bitfield name: FailedCommunication
* Bitfield summary: Communication failure to sensors or other safety equipment.
* Bit: 3
* Bitfield name: PositionFailure
* Bitfield summary: Device has failed to reach the desired position. e.g. with position aware device, time expired before TargetPosition is reached.
* Bit: 4
* Bitfield name: ThermalProtection
* Bitfield summary: Motor(s) and/or electric circuit thermal protection activated.
* Bit: 5
* Bitfield name: ObstacleDetected
* Bitfield summary: An obstacle is preventing actuator movement.
* Bit: 6
* Bitfield name: Power
* Bitfield summary: Device has power related issue or limitation e.g. device is running w/ the help of a backup battery or power might not be fully available at the moment.
* Bit: 7
* Bitfield name: StopInput
* Bitfield summary: Local safety sensor (not a direct obstacle) is preventing movements (e.g. Safety EU Standard EN60335).
* Bit: 8
* Bitfield name: MotorJammed
* Bitfield summary: Mechanical problem related to the motor(s) detected.
* Bit: 9
* Bitfield name: HardwareFailure
* Bitfield summary: PCB, fuse and other electrics problems.
* Bit: 10
* Bitfield name: ManualOperation
* Bitfield summary: Actuator is manually operated and is preventing actuator movement (e.g. actuator is disengaged/decoupled).
* Bit: 11
* Bitfield name: Protection
* Bitfield summary: Protection is activated.

Cluster Name: Thermostat Cluster
Cluster ID: 0x0201
Cluter History:
* Revision 1 - Mandatory global ClusterRevision attribute added; fixed some defaults; CCB 1823, 1480
* Revision 2 - CCB 1981 2186 2249 2250 2251; NFR Thermostat Setback
* Revision 3 - CCB 2477 2560 2773 2777 2815 2816 3029
* Revision 4 - All Hubs changes
* Revision 5 - New data model format and notation, added FeatureMap, collapsed attribute sets, clarified edge cases around limits, default value of xxxSetpointLimit now respects AbsxxxSetpointLimit
* Revision 6 - Introduced the LTNE feature and adapted text (spec issue #5778)
* Revision 7 - Update constraints on local temperature calibration and minimum setpoint deadband and introduced Presets and MatterScheduleConfiguration features
* Revision 8 - Added comment regarding writing to ControlSequenceOfOperation.
* Revision 9 - Removed AlarmMask attribute and AlarmCodeBitmap Type.

Cluster role: application
Cluster picsCode: TSTAT
Cluster scope: Endpoint

* Bitfield summary: Message has already been confirmed

Cluster scope: Node

parameter.name: EndpointRef
parameter.description: Reference to the Endpoint the Cluster {{object|#.Endpoint.}}

parameter.name: UTCTime
Granularity
parameter.description:
Matter Element ID: 0x0001
Matter Element Access: {'read': 'true', 'readPrivilege': 'view'}

enumeration.description: This indicates that the node is not currently synchronized with a UTC Time source and its clock is based on the Last Known Good UTC Time only.
This indicates the node was synchronized to an upstream source in the past, but sufficient clock drift has occurred such that the clock error is now > 5 seconds.
This indicates the node is synchronized to an upstream source using a low resolution protocol. UTC Time is accurate to ± 5 seconds.

This indicates the node is synchronized to an upstream source using high resolution time-synchronization protocol such as NTP, or has built-in GNSS with some amount of jitter applying its GNSS timestamp. UTC Time is accurate to ± 50 ms.
This indicates the node is synchronized to an upstream source using a highly precise time-synchronization protocol such as PTP, or has built-in GNSS. UTC time is accurate to ± 10 μs.

parameter.name: TimeSource

Cluter History:
* Revision 1 - Initial revision
* Revision 2 - Add constraint about switching from non-Idle to non-Idle modes. ChangeToModeResponse command: StatusText must be provided for InvalidInMode status. Deprecate the OnMode attribute and the related feature map bit. Add the Mapping mode tag.
* Revision 3 - Remove constraint on changing cleaning modes while the RVC Run Mode cluster is in a non-Idle mode. Continue to allow InvalidInMode response for devices that do not support such mode changes.
* Revision 4 - DirectModeChange made non-provisional

object.name: Search.
object.description: Matter Struct Data Type Name: ContentSearchStruct

object.name: Search.ParameterList.{i}.
object.description: This object represents a complex attributes list of the type ParameterStruct

enumeration.description: Actor represents an actor credited in video media content; for example, “Gaby Hoffman”
Channel represents the identifying data for a television channel; for example, "PBS"
A character represented in video media content; for example, “Snow White”
A director of the video media content; for example, “Spike Lee”

An event is a reference to a type of event; examples would include sports, music, or other types of events. For example, searching for "Football games" would search for a 'game' event entity and a 'football' sport entity.

A franchise is a video entity which can represent a number of video entities, like movies or TV shows. For example, take the fictional franchise "Intergalactic Wars" which represents a collection of movie trilogies, as well as animated and live action TV shows. This entity type was introduced to account for requests by customers such as "Find Intergalactic Wars movies", which would search for all 'Intergalactic Wars' programs of the MOVIE MediaType, rather than attempting to match to a single title.
Genre represents the genre of video media content such as action, drama or comedy.
League represents the categorical information for a sporting league; for example, "NCAA"
Popularity indicates whether the user asks for popular content.
The provider (MSP) the user wants this media to be played on; for example, "Netflix".
Sport represents the categorical information of a sport; for example, football
SportsTeam represents the categorical information of a professional sports team; for example, "University of Washington Huskies"
The type of content requested. Supported types are "Movie", "MovieSeries", "TVSeries", "TVSeason", "TVEpisode", "Trailer", "SportsEvent", "LiveEvent", and "Video"
Video represents the identifying data for a specific piece of video content; for example, "Manchester by the Sea".
Season represents the specific season number within a TV series.
Episode represents a specific episode number within a Season in a TV series.
Represents a search text input across many parameter types or even outside of the defined param types.

object.description: This object represents a complex attributes list of the type ParameterStruct

enumeration.description: Actor represents an actor credited in video media content; for example, “Gaby Hoffman”
Channel represents the identifying data for a television channel; for example, "PBS"
A character represented in video media content; for example, “Snow White”
A director of the video media content; for example, “Spike Lee”

An event is a reference to a type of event; examples would include sports, music, or other types of events. For example, searching for "Football games" would search for a 'game' event entity and a 'football' sport entity.

A franchise is a video entity which can represent a number of video entities, like movies or TV shows. For example, take the fictional franchise "Intergalactic Wars" which represents a collection of movie trilogies, as well as animated and live action TV shows. This entity type was introduced to account for requests by customers such as "Find Intergalactic Wars movies", which would search for all 'Intergalactic Wars' programs of the MOVIE MediaType, rather than attempting to match to a single title.
Genre represents the genre of video media content such as action, drama or comedy.
League represents the categorical information for a sporting league; for example, "NCAA"
Popularity indicates whether the user asks for popular content.
The provider (MSP) the user wants this media to be played on; for example, "Netflix".
Sport represents the categorical information of a sport; for example, football
SportsTeam represents the categorical information of a professional sports team; for example, "University of Washington Huskies"
The type of content requested. Supported types are "Movie", "MovieSeries", "TVSeries", "TVSeason", "TVEpisode", "Trailer", "SportsEvent", "LiveEvent", and "Video"
Video represents the identifying data for a specific piece of video content; for example, "Manchester by the Sea".
Season represents the specific season number within a TV series.
Episode represents a specific episode number within a Season in a TV series.
Represents a search text input across many parameter types or even outside of the defined param types.

Matter Command ID: 0x40
Command direction: commandToServer
Matter Command ID: 0x40
Matter Command response: Status
Matter Element Access: {'invokePrivilege': 'manage'}

enumeration.description: e.g., Light is turned on/off once.
e.g., Light is turned on/off over 1 second and repeated 15 times.
e.g., Colored light turns green for 1 second; non-colored light flashes twice.
e.g., Colored light turns orange for 8 seconds; non-colored light switches to the maximum brightness for 0.5s and then minimum brightness for 7.5s.
Complete the current effect sequence before terminating. e.g., if in the middle of a breathe effect (as above), first complete the current 1s breathe effect and then terminate the effect.
Terminate the effect as soon as possible.
Indicates the default effect is used

parameter.name: EndpointRef
parameter.description: Reference to the Endpoint the Cluster {{object|#.Endpoint.}}

parameter.name: CountdownTime
MainState
parameter.description:
Matter Element ID: 0x0001
Matter Element Access: {'read': 'true', 'readPrivilege': 'view'}

enumeration.description: Closure is stopped
Closure is actively moving
Closure is waiting before a motion (e.g. pre-heat, pre-check)
Closure is in an error state
Closure is currently calibrating its Opened and Closed limits to determine effective physical range
Some protective measures are activated to prevent damage to the closure. Commands MAY be rejected.
Closure has a disengaged element preventing any actuator movements
Movement commands are ignored since the closure is not operational and requires further setup and/or calibration

parameter.name: CurrentErrorList

enumeration.description: An obstacle is blocking the closure movement
The closure is unsafe to move, as determined by a sensor (e.g. photoelectric sensor) before attempting movement
A warning raised by the closure that indicates an over-temperature, e.g. due to excessive drive or stall current
Some malfunctions that are not easily recoverable are detected, or urgent servicing is needed
An internal element is prohibiting motion, e.g. an integrated door within a bigger garage door is open and prevents motion

parameter.name: LatchControlModes
parameter.description:
Matter Element ID: 0x0005
Matter Element Access: {'read': 'true', 'readPrivilege': 'view'}
Bitmaps SHALL be encoded using the TLV unsigned integer type, with the width selected automatically at runtime based on the actual value.
Matter type: LatchControlModesBitmap
* Bit: 0
* Bitfield name: RemoteLatching
* Bitfield summary: Remote latching capability
* Bit: 1
* Bitfield name: RemoteUnlatching
* Bitfield summary: Remote unlatching capability

object.description:
Cluster Name: Pump Configuration and Control Cluster
Cluster ID: 0x0200
Cluter History:
* Revision 1 - Mandatory global ClusterRevision attribute added
* Revision 2 - All Hubs changes

* Revision 4 - Added feature map
Cluster hierarchy: base

parameter.name: EndpointRef
parameter.description: Reference to the Endpoint the Cluster {{object|#.Endpoint.}}

parameter.name: MaxPressure
MaxSpeed
MaxFlow
MinConstPressure
MaxConstPressure
MinCompPressure
MaxCompPressure
MinConstSpeed
MaxConstSpeed
MinConstFlow
MaxConstFlow
MinConstTemp
MaxConstTemp
PumpStatus
parameter.description:
Matter Element ID: 0x0010
Matter Element Access: {'read': 'true', 'readPrivilege': 'view'}
Bitmaps SHALL be encoded using the TLV unsigned integer type, with the width selected automatically at runtime based on the actual value.
Matter type: PumpStatusBitmap
* Bit: 0
* Bitfield name: DeviceFault
* Bitfield summary: A fault related to the system or pump device is detected.
* Bit: 1
* Bitfield name: SupplyFault
* Bitfield summary: A fault related to the supply to the pump is detected.
* Bit: 2
* Bitfield name: SpeedLow
* Bitfield summary: Setpoint is too low to achieve.
* Bit: 3
* Bitfield name: SpeedHigh
* Bitfield summary: Setpoint is too high to achieve.
* Bit: 4
* Bitfield name: LocalOverride
* Bitfield summary: Device control is overridden by hardware, such as an external STOP button or via a local HMI.
* Bit: 5
* Bitfield name: Running
* Bitfield summary: Pump is currently running
* Bit: 6
* Bitfield name: RemotePressure
* Bitfield summary: A remote pressure sensor is used as the sensor for the regulation of the pump.
* Bit: 7
* Bitfield name: RemoteFlow
* Bitfield summary: A remote flow sensor is used as the sensor for the regulation of the pump.
* Bit: 8
* Bitfield name: RemoteTemperature
* Bitfield summary: A remote temperature sensor is used as the sensor for the regulation of the pump.

parameter.name: EffectiveOperationMode
parameter.description:
Matter Element ID: 0x0011
Matter Element Access: {'read': 'true', 'readPrivilege': 'view'}

enumeration.description: The pump is controlled by a setpoint, as defined by a connected remote sensor or by the ControlMode attribute.
This value sets the pump to run at the minimum possible speed it can without being stopped.
This value sets the pump to run at its maximum possible speed.
This value sets the pump to run with the local settings of the pump, regardless of what these are.

parameter.name: EffectiveControlMode
parameter.description:
Matter Element ID: 0x0012
Matter Element Access: {'read': 'true', 'readPrivilege': 'view'}

enumeration.description: The pump is running at a constant speed.
The pump will regulate its speed to maintain a constant differential pressure over its flanges.
The pump will regulate its speed to maintain a constant differential pressure over its flanges.
The pump will regulate its speed to maintain a constant flow through the pump.
The pump will regulate its speed to maintain a constant temperature.
The operation of the pump is automatically optimized to provide the most suitable performance with respect to comfort and energy savings.
